ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a seven-segment digital tube display circuit, with each segment a to g of the digital tube connected through resistors to the chip output terminals Ya to Yg labeled CD4511. Below the chip is labeled BCD Code Input, and the input terminals from left to right are clearly labeled A3, A2, A1, A0. Reasoning: CD4511 is a BCD-to-seven-segment display decoder; to display the decimal digit 2, the 4-bit BCD code of the digit 2 needs to be input.
